titleEn: The text textbook is in the Library
bodyZh: 文字课有一份完整教材，放在顶栏「书库」里，需要时再打开，不会自动弹出，也不会在每次提问时整段倒给你。现在的主路径仍然是：先看见它猜出一个词，再看词片、亮线和残差。
bodyEn: The text course has a full textbook in the top bar “Library”. Open it when you need it. It does not pop open by itself, and I will not dump it into every answer. The short path is still: watch it guess a word, then see pieces, lit lines, and the residual.
nextStepHintZh: 若只是要走通当前关，先回到「推进一步」。
nextStepHintEn: If you only need this station, return to “Take one step.”

titleEn: The image textbook is in the Library
bodyZh: 图片课的完整教材在顶栏「书库」里，用来把「再去噪一步」后面的原理补全。它不会自动打开。当前先把画布和对照小图看清。
bodyEn: The image course textbook is in the top bar “Library”, for going deeper after “denoise one step.” It does not auto-open. For now, map the canvas and the comparison thumbs.
nextStepHintZh: 先看画布，再决定要不要打开教材。
nextStepHintEn: Look at the canvas first, then decide whether to open the textbook.

titleEn: The music textbook is in the Library
bodyZh: 音乐课的完整教材在顶栏「书库」里，不会自动打开。当前先看清三块，并写出下一个音。
bodyEn: The music course textbook is in the top bar “Library” and does not auto-open. First map the three parts and write the next note.
nextStepHintZh: 先写出下一个音，再决定要不要打开教材。
nextStepHintEn: Write the next note first, then decide whether to open the textbook.

titleZh: 微调课 22 步教材在书库
titleEn: The 22-step fine-tune textbook is in the Library
bodyZh: 22 步教材沿同一条主线把原理补全，不另开目录，也不自动打开。「推进一步」不会替你翻开它。主线走完后再打开即可。
bodyEn: The 22-step textbook completes the same spine; it is not a second curriculum, and it does not auto-open. “Take one step” will not open it for you. Open it after the short path, when you need it.
citeZh: 出处：顶栏「书库」，以及主线上「需要时打开教材」。
citeEn: Source: the top bar “Library”, and “open the textbook when you need it” on the spine.
nextStepHintZh: 先走完当前这一关，再打开教材。
nextStepHintEn: Finish this station before opening the textbook.
